security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution and reconnaissance alerts are Markdown formatting false positives. The skill does make outbound BrowserAct API calls and reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY as part of its design. The main security concern is credential solicitation in chat-facing instructions, with an additional retry flow that can duplicate external tasks.

remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through environment variables or a secret manager. Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat or terminal prompts.

remediation.issue: External API calls send data to BrowserAct
remediation.suggestion: Document the BrowserAct endpoint, transmitted fields, and credential use. Ask for user confirmation before starting network tasks.

remediation.issue: Polling flow can trigger duplicate external tasks
remediation.suggestion: Retrieve task details after a finished status instead of returning a timeout. Make retries explicit and check existing task state first.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Solicitation in Agent Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to request the BrowserAct API key, and the script tells users to provide it to the agent. This can expose API keys in chat transcripts or logs instead of protected secret storage.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both cited lines explicitly direct users toward sharing the API key outside a secret store. This is a clear credential-handling risk even though the API integration itself is expected.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Retry Can Duplicate External Tasks
semantic_findings.description: The script starts a BrowserAct task, but the polling flow returns a timeout error before the result retrieval block. The documented retry policy can then create duplicate external jobs and consume API quota.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: When status is finished, the loop breaks and then always reaches the timeout return, making the retrieval block unreachable. The skill also instructs one automatic retry after failure.

content.value_statement: Amazon review research is slow when users collect feedback manually. This skill submits an ASIN to BrowserAct and gathers structured review data for analysis.
actual_capabilities: Submits an Amazon ASIN to a BrowserAct workflow template.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment for authentication.
Polls BrowserAct task status with timestamped progress messages.
Reports invalid authorization, task failure, and network errors.
Documents expected review fields such as rating, title, text, date, country, variant, and verified status.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and outbound network access.
Works only for valid ASINs supported by the BrowserAct workflow.
Results depend on BrowserAct availability and Amazon page access.
Users must verify compliance with Amazon terms and privacy rules.

use_cases.title: Monitor Product Feedback
use_cases.description: Collect recent reviews for one product and summarize common praise, complaints, and quality signals.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Reviews
use_cases.description: Run review collection for competitor ASINs and compare ratings, issues, and verified purchase themes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sentiment Inputs
use_cases.description: Gather review text and metadata before running sentiment analysis or classification workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Collect One Product
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single ASIN.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Amazon reviews skill for ASIN B07TS6R1SF. Summarize the main rating trends and customer themes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Verified Purchases
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect reviews for ASIN B08N5WRWJ6. Highlight verified purchase feedback, repeated issues, and positive product features.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the skill for these ASINs one at a time: B07TS6R1SF and B08N5WRWJ6. Compare complaints, strengths, and rating patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Build Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect reviews for the target ASIN. Create a research brief with sentiment themes, defect signals, variant notes, and evidence counts.

output_examples.input: Collect reviews for one ASIN and summarize customer sentiment.
output_examples.output: The result highlights common positive themes, repeated complaints, rating distribution clues, and notable verified purchase feedback.

output_examples.input: Compare reviews for two competitor ASINs.
output_examples.output: The comparison separates strengths, weaknesses, recurring quality issues, and review themes for each product.

output_examples.input: Find product quality risks from review text.
output_examples.output: The analysis lists frequent defect mentions, affected variants, review dates, and representative customer concerns.

best_practices: Store the BrowserAct API key in an environment variable or secret manager.
Run one ASIN at a time and confirm results before starting large batches.
Review collected data for privacy, terms, and retention requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat messages or shared logs.
Do not retry failed runs repeatedly without checking task status.
Do not treat extracted reviews as complete market truth without validation.

faq.question: What does this skill need to run?
faq.answer: It needs Python, outbound network access, a valid BrowserAct API key, and an Amazon ASIN.

faq.question: Does it require an Amazon login?
faq.answer: The skill documentation says it uses BrowserAct review extraction without an Amazon account login.

faq.question: Where should I store the API key?
faq.answer: Store it in BROWSERACT_API_KEY or a secret manager. Avoid sharing it in chat or logs.

faq.question: What review fields are expected?
faq.answer: Expected fields include reviewer name, profile link, rating, title, review text, date, country, variant, and verified status.

faq.question: Can it compare several products?
faq.answer: Yes. Run the workflow for each ASIN, then compare the collected results across products.

faq.question: What should I verify before publishing results?
faq.answer: Check data accuracy, privacy obligations, Amazon terms, and whether review samples are representative.
